Premium crafted symbol with refined 2.5D polish, not photorealistic fur, not noisy micro-detail, not crude flat clipart. Readable when reduced to 48–96px; prioritize outline and distinct internal shape separation. Completely frameless: NO circular ring, NO halo, NO surrounding border, NO medallion, NO enclosing disk, NO shield, NO box, NO ornamental backdrop. No gems, jewels, crown, fire, lightning, particles, sparkles, theatrical bloom, or realistic flesh. Subject alone floating on a completely transparent background. The subject occupies 72–80 percent of square canvas with clear breathing room; all tips fully visible inside canvas. No ground shadow. No text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark or UI. G2: one elegant gently curved feather, slim shaft and clearly separated sweeping barbs, slanted diagonal with a naturally pointed tip. It should be visually more sophisticated than a basic white flat feather through carved satin facets and carefully formed rib grooves, but still one simple coherent feather. Jade mint and silver finish, restrained glossy highlights. No quill pen tool, no ink or extra objects.
